title: NASA's Psyche Spacecraft Peeks at Mars, Prepares for Asteroid
summary: NASA's Psyche spacecraft made a close flyby of Mars on May 15, approaching to 2,864 miles. The maneuver used a gravity assist to boost speed and change the spacecraft's orbital plane without using onboard propellant, setting it on course for the metal-rich asteroid Psyche. A related video is available but no transcript is provided.

NASA's Psyche spacecraft completed its close approach of Mars on May 15, coming within 2,864 miles of the Red Planet.

This flyby used a gravity assist from Mars to provide a critical boost in speed and to adjust the spacecraft's orbital plane without using any onboard propellant, sending it on its way toward the metal-rich asteroid Psyche.
